Interrogative Pronoun 怎么 (1)
你叫什么名字？ (Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?) - What's your name? (example (1) of the interrogative pronoun 什么)
这是什么？ (Zhè shì shénme?) - What is this? (example (2) of the interrogative pronoun 什么)
这是什么书？ (Zhè shì shénme shū?) - What book is this? (example (3) of the interrogative pronoun 什么)
谁是李月？ (Shéi shì Lǐ Yuè?) - Who is Li Yue? (example of the interrogative pronoun 谁)
她是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is she? (example of the interrogative pronoun 谁)
他是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is he? (example of the interrogative pronoun 谁)
